kurz: Prawns cook in a minute or two: even a little too long makes their protein contract tightly, squeeze out juice and turn rubbery.
bild_im_kopf: Like a hair tie wound too tight: briefly stretched it springs, overstretched it turns hard and stiff.
faustregeln: For juicy prawns: short and hot, better half a minute too early than too late, because they keep cooking in a hot sauce.
Fried in their shells they stay juicier; the shell protects them from direct heat.

ursachen.warum: Prawns are thin and lean. They are done as soon as they are pink and no longer glassy, often after one to two minutes per side.
fix: Take them out as soon as they are pink and just white inside
Rule of thumb: a C shape is done, an O shape is overdone

ursachen.titel: Too little heat, they stew in their own juice
ursachen.warum: In a crowded or lukewarm pan juice runs out and stays there. The prawns boil instead of frying and need longer.
fix: Let the pan get properly hot
Pat the prawns dry and don't add too many at once

ursachen.warum: Frozen prawns lose water when thawed. Some are treated with salts that bind water and turn watery and spongy when fried.
fix: Thaw slowly in the fridge and pat very dry

q1.frage: Did you take them out as soon as they were pink and no longer glassy?

q2.frage: Was there a lot of liquid in the pan, did they simmer rather than fry?
